jobs.occupation: Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center is seeking, starting in January 2027, a Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement.

The Single-cell Open Lab (scOpenLab) provides state-of-the-art infrastructure and scientific expertise for single-cell sequencing and spatial omics. Our goal is to enable researchers to perform advanced experiments independently: we advise users on experimental design, provide hands-on training, and support them throughout project optimization, experimental implementation, and library preparation.

Our technology portfolio covers a broad range of single-cell and multi-omic approaches, including single-cell RNA, DNA, and chromatin profiling, as well as spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics. Beyond providing access to established technologies, method development is an important part of our work. We continuously evaluate, adapt, and establish emerging single-cell and spatial technologies and develop customized experimental workflows. Examples include HIPSDR-seq for joint single-cell DNA and RNA profiling and the implementation of new spatial omics approaches. The scOpenLab is also closely involved in MultiSpace, the platform for spatial omics within the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim. Through MultiSpace, we collaborate with other technology platforms and research groups to enable multimodal spatial profiling and the integration of spatial transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular readouts.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a research scientist to cover a period of parental leave and join our interdisciplinary team. The position combines user support and training with hands-on experimental work and technology development, offering the opportunity to work at the forefront of rapidly evolving single-cell and spatial omics technologies with the following tasks:

- Planning and designing spatially resolved transcriptome and proteomics projects with our users
- Training of new users for spatial and single-cell omics assays
- Optimization and integration of new methods in the lab with a focus on multimodal approaches
- Organizing and driving early access programmes
- Scheduling and maintenance of service infrastructure for image-based spatial transcriptomics

Your Profile

- University degree in life science (MSc), additional PhD preferred
- Experience and very good knowledge of NGS techniques, library preparation, tissue handling, and imaging (skills in data analysis are a plus)
- Previous work in the single-cell field is certainly an advantage
- Very good knowledge of English and German
- Self-motivation and innovative thinking will be required for the successful implementation of your work. This also includes excellent communication and organizational skills.

Please provide both a CV and a cover letter.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Jan-Philipp Mallm
Phone: +49 (0)6221/54-51378

Duration: The position is initially limited until 31.12.2027. An extension is possible.

Application Deadline: October 22, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about shaping the future of biologics development and driving scientific excellence in analytical and microbiological safety strategies? Join Boehringer Ingelheim's CMC Development Biologicals organization and play a key leadership role within the Quality Control team, where you will influence strategic decisions, engage with regulatory authorities and scientific communities, and advance innovative solutions across our development pipeline. Leading a team of highly ambitious experts, you will help strengthen our microbiological and viral safety capabilities while delivering scientific and regulatory excellence for patients worldwide.
Ready to make a meaningful impact and shape the future of biological medicines? We look forward to receiving your application.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
This position has a hybrid setup with a minimum of 3 days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead your team by providing clear directions, prioritizing tasks and developing strategies.
- Furthermore, you will contribute to the Quality Control Leadership Team by making continuous improvements, strengthening the team's impact across the development value chain, and leading project-related initiatives.
- You will also Initiate and lead innovation projects by identifying strategic needs in the organization
- In addition, you will develop and maintain solid microbial and virus-safety strategies.
- You will actively contribute and influence the scientific and regulatory community by representing Boehringer Ingelheim at conferences and in industry consortia
- Finally, you will shape the microbiology network within Boehringer Ingelheim and ensure seamless interfaces.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in Virology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Biology or Biochemistry, or a related quantitative scientific discipline
- Strong scientific expertise in microbiology and virology, with a proven ability to apply knowledge in a research and development environment
- In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices related to microbiology and virology
- Solid knowledge of Novel Biological Entity (NBE) development principles, processes, and associated requirements
- Passion for innovation and emerging technologies, particularly in the detection, characterization, and monitoring of viruses and microorganisms
- Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities
- Demonstrated leadership experience is a plus
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, supported by a strong professional network

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:

Work Schedule

Job Description

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Location:

Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central Germany
Ideally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or Berlin

Discover Impactful Work
Join our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.

In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.

You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.

A Day in the Life:
You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.

You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.

What to expect:

- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.
- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.
- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.
- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.
- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.
- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.
- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.
- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).

Keys to Success:
Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.

Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.
- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.
- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.
- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.
- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.
- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).
- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.

Benefits:

jobs.occupation: Supplier Quality Engineer (f/m/d) for Gas Turbine Auxiliaries, Electrical Systems (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the Electrical Auxiliary Systems of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global supply chain Team. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Electrical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes Power Control Center (Electrical/Instrumentation/Controls), Switchboards, Panel Boards, Switchgears, Low Voltage Transformers, Starting Frequency Converter, Static Excitation System, Batteries & Charging Systems, E-houses, Cables, and Bus Ducting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and final product inspection during Factory Acceptance Test for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification of our electrical components. Create inspection reports and follow up with punch list
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified supplier non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary
* Supplier Performance: Track Supplier performance, create reports and take adequate measures to implement supplier quality improvement- or risk mitigation measures
* Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality tools landscape e.g. to create process transparency or generate performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above
* Knowledge and experience in auditing, with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred
* Familiarity with quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, and RCA
* Understanding of specific component technologies and standards (or equivalents) like NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and UL is an advantage
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time and strong communication skills in English

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy
* We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Air Power Engineering - Mission Systems , Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronic Warfare Developer (d/m/f)

The successful applicant will join the Combat Algorithm Development and Prototyping team within the Mission System Center of Competence, dedicated for bridging the gap between theoretical mathematical models and deployable, real-world combat systems.

The team designs, codes, and validates high-performance algorithms that drive autonomous decision-making, target acquisition, and mission optimization. By rapidly prototyping these solutions, it is ensured that the relevant technologies are robust, scalable, and ready for integration into next-generation defence platforms.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

In this position you will be in charge to:

- Support the development of EMO Management software components for Spectrum Management and the EMO Decision Advisor
- Work on the "classical (non-AI)" part of the EMO (Electro-Magnetic Operations) Decision Advisor
- Integrate software components up to TRL5 and (possibly) support the handover to the product development team
- Perform integration and testing of software components in combination with the simulation tool JADES

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master´s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
- Analytical Thinking: Ability to simplify complex, abstract concepts into practical software solutions.
- Collaboration & Communication: Effective team player comfortable working in cross-functional, multi-disciplinary engineering environments.
- Precision & Quality: Strong attention to detail regarding code robustness, integration testing, and documentation standards.
- English: Business fluent (written and spoken)

Required:

- Working with VS-NfD data
- Capability to translate (abstract) concepts into executable source code
- Programming skills in C
- Software development experience using an IDE (currently Eclipse is used)
- Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Doxygen, Git, Wireshark and Matlab
- Knowledge of Linux on command line level

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Mass Properties department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mass Properties department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: January 2027
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our mission

Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Python Software Development: Develop, maintain, and improve Python-based applications and reusable software components for managing aircraft mass data.
- Database Management: Support the design and implementation of database structures, queries, and data models using relational databases.
- Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive engineering workflows and data-processing tasks to increase efficiency.
- Data Integration & Processing: Develop tools for importing, validating, transforming, and integrating data from various engineering sources and tools.
- AI Research & Prototyping: Investigate and evaluate the application of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) by developing prototypes for engineering workflows.
- Software Quality Assurance: Ensure software reliability by developing automated/manual test cases, documenting bugs, and improving code maintainability.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Data Science, Informatics, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Good programming skills in Python and a strong interest in software development.
- Basic knowledge or a strong interest in the following areas: SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Software architecture and Object-Oriented Programming, Data processing, automation, and software testing.
- Interest in learning and working with technologies such as: PyQt for GUI development, Git for version control, Jira and Confluence for project management, AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Ability to translate complex engineering problems into structured software solutions through a self-organized and analytical way of working.
- Advanced English; German is a plus.
